name: fix_aspnet_di_lifetime
description: Fixes a Transient DI lifetime that gives every request a fresh empty repository
prompts: The cart API loses everything: CartRepository is registered with AddTransient in Program.cs, so every resolution constructs a brand-new empty repository - every POST /cart returns id 1 and GET /cart is always empty. Fix the registration so the in-memory repository is shared for the application's lifetime (a singleton): items persist across requests, ids auto-increment (1, 2, ...), and GET /cart lists everything added. Note that AddScoped is NOT enough - a scope is per-request, so state would still vanish between requests. Don't change Repositories/CartRepository.cs, and do not create or modify anything under tests/.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

test_setup_files.tests/tests.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>

  <ItemGroup>

  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="../app.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
